QuestInfo.0: You collected the Flashy Mask. Now go and get information from the townspeople.
QuestInfo.1: You need to teach the Insane Masquerade Citizens a lesson.

0.0: I am happy. Are you happy? I faced insanity once, and I will never get back what they took from me.
0.1: 100 will be enough. Those 100 will fill my soul with happiness. The #bInsane Masquerade Citizens#k will know justice. Sweet, sweet justice.

yes.0: The place is #bRevelation Place 2#k, the time is now. Make them suffer. Make them learn.

0.msg: You are a true educator. Oh friend, teacher, stranger, and fighter. Be happy. Speak of happiness.

yes.0: Focus on the Dark Mask. You are a teacher again.

default.0: 100 Insane Masquerade Citizens. Go to Revelation Place 2. I won't be going.
